profiles.name: AI & Automation Readiness
profiles.description: Scores visible evidence of AI initiatives and digital/transformation capacity from homepage content only.

dimensions.name: AI Maturity
dimensions.description: Visible evidence of AI/ML product initiatives, automation investment, and AI hiring on the homepage.
evidence_hints: Existing AI initiatives (product/feature mentions, AI-powered offerings)
AI research or announcements referenced on the page
AI/ML hiring signals (only if careers/hiring content appears on this page)
Investment in automation tools / intelligent workflows
dimensions.rubric: 1-3 = little/no visible AI evidence on homepage; 4-6 = some AI/automation mentions without depth; 7-10 = clear, concrete AI product/initiative evidence.

dimensions.name: Transformation Readiness
dimensions.description: Visible evidence the company has scale and digital maturity to undertake transformation.
evidence_hints: Company size / scale signals
Tech maturity (cloud, API, platform, modern digital product language)
Past digital/transformation initiatives mentioned on the page
Industry digitalization context (only if supported by page + stated industry)
Leadership openness to change (strategy/innovation/digital quotes on the page only)
dimensions.rubric: 1-3 = little readiness evidence on homepage; 4-6 = mixed or partial signals; 7-10 = strong, concrete transformation/digital readiness evidence.

few_shots.label: strong
few_shots.homepage_text: NexusCloud builds AI-powered supply-chain software for manufacturers. Our AI Engineer and ML Platform roles are open on Careers. Press: 'NexusCloud invests $12M in warehouse automation with computer vision' — product line includes Predictive Restock AI.

ai_maturity.reason: Page cites 'AI-powered supply-chain software', open 'AI Engineer' / 'ML Platform' roles, and press about '$12M in warehouse automation with computer vision' plus 'Predictive Restock AI'.

transformation_readiness.reason: Mentions manufacturers as customers, 'warehouse automation', and a funded product platform — concrete digital transformation investment language on the homepage.

few_shots.label: poor
few_shots.homepage_text: Harbor Street Grill — family restaurant since 1987. Open Tue–Sun for dinner. Menu: seafood, steaks, weekend brunch. Catering for local events. Call (555) 014-2200. No online ordering; walk-ins welcome. About: 'We cook from scratch with local produce.'

ai_maturity.reason: Substantial homepage content (menu, hours, catering) with zero AI/automation/tech product language — no evidence found in available content (not a confirmed absence of all AI elsewhere).

transformation_readiness.reason: Page is a local restaurant with 'No online ordering' and no cloud/API/digital-transformation language — limited evidence of enterprise transformation readiness from homepage content.

few_shots.label: mixed
few_shots.homepage_text: BrightPath Consulting helps mid-market firms thrive. We support 'digital transformation' journeys and change management workshops. Services: strategy, training, process improvement. Clients across retail and logistics. Contact us for a discovery call.

ai_maturity.reason: Homepage says 'digital transformation' journeys but has no AI/ML product, hiring, or automation specifics — limited evidence available from homepage content.

transformation_readiness.reason: Generic 'digital transformation' and 'change management workshops' for mid-market firms appear, but no concrete timeline, tech stack, or completed initiative is described — ambiguous signal only.

profiles.name: Sustainability & Energy Transition Fit
profiles.description: Scores visible evidence of sustainability initiatives and energy-transition / green-tech posture from homepage content only.

dimensions.name: Sustainability Initiatives
dimensions.description: Visible evidence of ESG reporting, net-zero/climate goals, green certifications, or sustainability programs.
evidence_hints: ESG / sustainability reports or scorecards mentioned
Net-zero, carbon reduction, or climate targets
Green certifications (LEED, ISO 14001, B Corp, etc.)
Recycling, circular economy, or responsible sourcing programs
dimensions.rubric: 1-3 = little/no sustainability language; 4-6 = generic green claims without specifics; 7-10 = concrete targets, certifications, or published ESG evidence.

dimensions.name: Energy Transition
dimensions.description: Visible evidence of renewable energy, efficiency investments, green-tech partnerships, or clean-energy products.
evidence_hints: Renewable energy use or procurement
Energy efficiency / electrification investments
Green tech partnerships or clean-energy product lines
Decarbonization or energy-transition roadmap language
dimensions.rubric: 1-3 = no energy-transition signals; 4-6 = vague efficiency or 'green' mentions; 7-10 = specific renewables, partnerships, or transition investments.

few_shots.label: strong
few_shots.homepage_text: GreenGrid Logistics runs a net-zero by 2035 program. ESG Report 2024 shows 40% renewable fleet power. Partners with Vestas on warehouse solar. ISO 14001 certified across EU hubs.

sustainability_initiatives.reason: Page cites 'net-zero by 2035', 'ESG Report 2024', and 'ISO 14001 certified' — concrete sustainability program evidence.

energy_transition.reason: Mentions '40% renewable fleet power' and partnership 'with Vestas on warehouse solar' — clear energy-transition investment language.

few_shots.label: poor
few_shots.homepage_text: CityPrint Copy Shop — same-day flyers and business cards. Open Mon–Fri. Cash and card accepted. No delivery. About: 'Family owned since 1999.'

sustainability_initiatives.reason: Substantial local-business homepage with zero ESG, climate, or sustainability language — no evidence found in available content.

energy_transition.reason: No renewable, efficiency, or green-tech language on the page — limited evidence available from homepage content.

few_shots.label: mixed
few_shots.homepage_text: NorthPeak Manufacturing is 'committed to a greener future.' We reduce waste where possible and explore cleaner energy options. Contact sustainability@northpeak.example for details.

sustainability_initiatives.reason: Page says 'committed to a greener future' and 'reduce waste where possible' without targets, reports, or certifications — limited evidence available from homepage content.

energy_transition.reason: Mentions 'explore cleaner energy options' with no renewables share, partners, or timeline — ambiguous energy-transition signal only.

profiles.name: SaaS & Digital Adoption Fit
profiles.description: Scores visible evidence of software/SaaS usage and digital-first operations from homepage content only.

dimensions.name: SaaS / Software Tooling
dimensions.description: Visible evidence the company already uses or sells modern software/SaaS tools.
evidence_hints: Named SaaS/software tools or tech stack mentions
Cloud product or subscription language
Customer portal / self-serve product UX
Integrations marketplace or app ecosystem
dimensions.rubric: 1-3 = little software/SaaS evidence; 4-6 = generic 'digital tools' without names; 7-10 = concrete SaaS products, stack, or portal evidence.

dimensions.name: Digital-First Operations
dimensions.description: Visible evidence of API/integration readiness and digitally native go-to-market or operations.
evidence_hints: API, webhook, or integration language
Online ordering, e-commerce, or digital channels as primary
Automation of workflows / ops
Remote/hybrid digital delivery models
dimensions.rubric: 1-3 = offline/traditional ops only; 4-6 = some digital channels without depth; 7-10 = clear API/digital-ops evidence.

few_shots.label: strong
few_shots.homepage_text: ParcelOps Cloud is a SaaS TMS for shippers. REST API and 80+ integrations (Shopify, NetSuite). Customer portal with live tracking. Pricing: Starter / Growth / Enterprise seats.

saas_tooling.reason: Page calls out 'SaaS TMS', seat-based pricing, and 'Customer portal' — clear SaaS product evidence.

digital_operations.reason: Cites 'REST API' and '80+ integrations (Shopify, NetSuite)' — strong digital-ops and integration language.

few_shots.label: poor
few_shots.homepage_text: Maple Street Hardware — nails, lumber, paint. Visit our storefront downtown. Hours posted on the door. Phone orders only; no website shopping cart.

saas_tooling.reason: Local hardware storefront page with no software, SaaS, or portal mentions — no evidence found in available content.

digital_operations.reason: Page says 'Phone orders only; no website shopping cart' — limited digital-ops evidence from homepage content.

few_shots.label: mixed
few_shots.homepage_text: Apex Field Services uses 'modern digital tools' to coordinate crews. Clients can email job updates. We are exploring an online booking page next year.

saas_tooling.reason: Says 'modern digital tools' without naming products or SaaS stack — limited evidence available from homepage content.

digital_operations.reason: Email job updates and 'exploring an online booking page' show partial digital intent without API/integration proof — ambiguous signal only.
